votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 15 of 2024, 900 South Housing and Transit Reinvestment Zone Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City
votes.description: Approves the interlocal agreement between Salt Lake City Corporation and the RDA to create the 900 South Housing and Transit Reinvestment Zone project area, outlining participating taxing entities, tax increment participation rates, term of collection, and planned utilization of funds.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 16 of 2024, Liberty Corner Daycare Loan of 1.6 Million Dollars
votes.description: Approves an additional $1,600,000 loan to Liberty Corner Associates, LLC for construction of an expanded commercial daycare facility in the Liberty Corner affordable multifamily development, capable of serving up to 160 children.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 17 of 2024, amending the North Temple RDA Project area as shown on the map
votes.description: Amends the boundaries of the North Temple Urban Renewal Project Area to remove properties that overlap with the Utah Fairpark Area Investment and Restoration District, as required by state legislation passed earlier in 2024.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 18 of 2024, authorizing the fully discounted conveyance of portions of the RDA property to Salt Lake City for the extension of the S-Line
votes.description: Authorizes a fully discounted land conveyance of nearly 14,000 square feet along Simpson Avenue to Salt Lake City Corporation to accommodate the extension of the S-Line Streetcar from McClelland Street to Highland Drive.

Sets the date of Tuesday, November 12, 2024 to accept public comment and consider adopting a resolution amending the RDA's final budget for Fiscal Year 2024-25, including allocating additional funding to the State Street commercial revolving loans program for the Liberty Corner daycare facility.
